name: Scientific case-memory query
description: Retrieve precedent scientific episodes for a supplied open-problem JSON and return the four-stage retrieval report with per-case reasons, adaptation requirements and a hypothesis-conditional forecast. Planning-only model predictions; never measurements. Disabled by default (feature flag MAESTRO_CASE_MEMORY_ENABLED); pass research_mode for evaluation.
use_when: A typed open problem (assay, context, two competing hypotheses) is supplied and planning needs precedent cases with explicit adaptation requirements.
do_not_use_when: A measured result, a mechanism verdict, or an update to biological evidence is required; forecasts from this tool are model predictions and admit no evidence.
